subfamily: Collins: a riff on Eben Klemm's Collins d'Electra (at Pico, which opened in 2001; Proper p. 135 gives only gin, vodka and a fresh rosemary syrup), with proportions on the Codex Tom Collins frame (p. 138), seasoned with the stand-in for orange bitters Klemm describes at the Campbell Apartment (Cointreau and Angostura, Proper p. 135; proportions mine)
glass: tall (Collins) glass, chilled, filled with ice
_status: v1 (Tomás, round 3), ruled by Wren round 4; notes fixed round 5 (Hester X6). Sweep (96 variants): gin 40% and 47% x split 30/30, 40/20, 45/15 x rosemary syrup 15/17.5/20/22.5 ml x Cointreau 5/7.5 ml x soda 45/60 ml, lemon 30, Angostura 2 dashes. Chosen 30/30, syrup 20, Cointreau 5, soda 60: in range at both gin strengths (14.0% / 6.85 g / 0.875% at 47%; 13.0% at 40%). Syrup 15 is OUT low on sugar with soda 60 (5.52); 22.5 + Cointreau 7.5 + soda 45 is OUT high (8.25); soda 45 runs strength OUT above 15% at 47% gin. Veto-free.
